name: FA19
driverConfig: 10BA (4× custom Knowles bass + 2× Knowles ED mid + 4× Knowles SWFK treble)

materials.cable: 8-strand 224-wire pure silver Litz with twist-lock modular plugs

accessories: Extensive tip selection (silicone, foam, SpinFit, HS18)
pros: Excellent pure silver cable and modular plugs
cons: Very low impedance requires a clean, low-noise source
Can sound analytical depending on preference
insight: FA19 is FiiO’s pure balanced-armature flagship using ten custom Knowles drivers. Reviewers praise its resolution, layering, and the high-quality pure silver cable. The very low 10Ω impedance means source pairing is important, but when driven well it delivers a refined, technical pure-BA experience.
